depiction.primary_object: outlined rectangular briefcase or suitcase with top handle
modifiers: filled circular badge at bottom right containing a downward-pointing arrow
depiction.composition: single object in front view with a bottom-right corner overlay badge

readings.meaning: pack luggage or put items into a suitcase
download work files, portfolio, or project archive
save or archive a business project

ambiguity: The base shape serves as both a travel suitcase and an office briefcase, and at small sizes it can also resemble a camera body or shopping bag with a download badge.

modifier_semantics.meaning: download, import, pack into, or drop off

task_intents: download work files for offline use
check in or drop off luggage
store seasonal gear in travel trunk

reasoning: The icon combines a clear briefcase/suitcase outline with a downward-arrow badge, naturally signifying either packing/dropping off luggage for travel or downloading/archiving work files. It fits common travel packing and work archiving tasks well, though the dual meaning of briefcase vs. suitcase and pack vs. download creates mild ambiguity.
